text: I've been trying to get through for ages now and I'd really appreciate someone getting back to me. I'm a foster carer and I've got a 2 year old boy with me who's had a temperature since yesterday, it was 39.8 when I checked about ten minutes ago, which is the highest it's been. He's had runny poos today, three or four of them, but he's drinking really well, he's had loads of water and his milk, and he's weeing normally, wet nappies all day. There's been no fit or shaking or jerking or anything like that, I've been watching him like a hawk. I've given him a dose of calpol earlier and I want to know if I can give anything else on top or if I just have to wait. I also need to know if I should be taking him somewhere tonight because I'll have to arrange cover for the other kids and I can't do that last minute. I've done everything I'm supposed to do, I've written it all down for the social worker, I just need a straight answer from somebody please, I've been sat here holding the phone for over an hour.
